subject: Temporary P1 coverage transition plan for CloudNova pilot expansion
messages:

Subject: Question on overnight P1 coverage as pilot expands

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudnova.com>
Date: 2026-02-11T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed temporary coverage & escalation plan (draft)

Hi team — draft proposal below for CloudNova while we complete the on-call staffing transition (2/19–3/05).

Proposal summary:
- Effective window: 2026-02-19 23:00 PST -> 2026-03-05 07:00 PST
- Temporary P1 routing: escalate first to Dedicated overnight on-call pool (90m technical response target), with automatic fallback to daytime on-call if no acknowledgement in 90 minutes.
- P2 handling remains unchanged (8h response).
- Compensating controls: phone bridge within 10 minutes for any unacknowledged P1 escalations; daily status email to CloudNova SRE during the window.
- Credits: We propose a one-time service credit clause if a P1 is missed twice in the window; commercial to confirm.

Attachments: oncall-gap-runbook-draft.md (operational steps), sla-exception-request-form.pdf (formal request).

Open questions:
1) Legal sign-off on exception wording? (Samir looped legal)
2) CloudNova approval of fallback timings & credit trigger.
3) Leadership approval for the temporary change (Evelyn tagged for visibility).

If this looks reasonable I can push the exception form for signatures and schedule the PD runbook test.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference
---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudnova.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, chloe_martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@cloudnova.com
Date: 2026-02-12T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed temporary coverage & escalation plan (draft)

Laura — thanks for the thorough draft. A few quick points from CloudNova:

- We can accept a temporary 90m technical response for overnight P1s as long as the phone-bridge fallback is enforced and the daily status updates are provided.
- Please quantify the credit: is it a percentage credit per missed P1 or a flat cap? Our procurement/legal team (cc'd) will need the exact language.
- We want a named point-of-contact on the Redwood side for high-severity follow-ups during the window.

If you can circulate the signed exception form and runbook, we'll expedite internal approval.

Regards,
Samir
